name: beevi
description: Create, schedule and publish on-brand social content from your Beevi workspaces.

interface.longDescription:
Beevi is a social media management tool for small businesses: it creates, schedules and publishes social media posts based on your brand. It learns your brand — voice, colours, products, people, places — and writes and designs content that sounds like you.

Connect this plugin to your Beevi account to manage your social media from ChatGPT:

• Draft posts grounded in your brand profile, saved memories and past content.
• Generate cover images, carousels and short video clips using your own photos, products and brand colours.
• Plan multi-post campaigns around a launch, a season or an event.
• Review what is queued, edit any platform's version of a post, and schedule or publish to LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, YouTube and Google Business Profile.
• Check the Weekly Compass — a research digest of what is worth posting about this week for your industry.

Everything runs against your own Beevi workspaces. Publishing is always an explicit action you confirm. You can revoke this connection at any time from Settings → API keys in Beevi.

Requires a Beevi account.
defaultPrompt: What should I post this week?
Write a LinkedIn post about our new opening hours
Plan a campaign for our summer menu
